title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Following up on Friday text, if you want to give me a ring today or tomorrow, I can tell you some of the points I’m hitting in my season-ending column
And you can tell me I’m full of it, etc. no quotes, attribution. If today, try later. Still putting it together.
I have to file it by tomorrow night so they can post Monday morning
Ok I will call you in a few minutes
